items.q: What does finding your life's task actually give you?
items.a: It installs **internal radar**: energy concentrates, distractions get cut, and mornings have direction. Purpose is a **compass**, not a single job title that narrows all of life.

items.q: Where does that power come from?
items.a: You are a **phenomenon** — DNA plus experience unique in cosmic history. That uniqueness is your **source of power**, not a three-minute personality quiz.

items.q: How do you spot your life-task seed?
items.a: Around age **4–5**, Maslow's **impulse voices** whisper what you love and hate. Famous seeds: Einstein's compass, Jobs hypnotized by electronics, Tiger Woods and golf balls, Greene obsessed with **words and early humans**.

items.q: What does Gardner's multiple intelligences add?
items.a: Your brain has a **grain** — linguistic, logical-mathematical, kinesthetic, social, and more. Go with the grain rather than forcing a mismatched path; *Five Frames of Mind* maps the frames.

items.q: Why do most people lose the signal by adulthood?
items.a: By age **7+**, teachers, parents, and peer noise drown the inner voice. Money-only work choices **disconnect you emotionally** — discipline fails without love of the work.

items.q: How much faster do you learn when emotionally engaged?
items.a: Emotionally engaged brains learn **2–4× faster**. Greene's Paris French clicked in **one month** versus four years of college because stakes and a relationship made it survival.

items.q: What does Huberman add about plasticity?
items.a: Brain change requires **neurochemical release**; without agitation (positive or negative), there is **no rewiring**. Comfort = no change. Love-before-hate matters — early hate can turn off learning in general.

items.q: Is it too late if you missed your path in your 20s?
items.a: Greene found his exact path at **38–39**. Recovery is **archaeological** — dig childhood bones. Experiment in your 20s within a framework; the life task guides trials, not a fixed destination.

Humans are plopped into an environment without knowing if they're **aquatic, terrestrial, or avian**. Purpose **restricts the landscape to your wedge** — wrong niche wastes years. His seed signal was **visceral bodily activation**, not intellectual delight alone.
